title: 个人外汇管理办法 (PBOC Decree No. 3 [2006])
supports: Definition of 境内个人 (PRC ID) vs 境外个人 (passport/HK-MO-TW resident); annual-quota rule governs 境内个人 purchases; Art. 13 境外个人 current-account purchase-and-remit right; Art. 22 境外个人 property-sale remittance with SAFE approval; Art. 37 definitions.

title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则，汇发[2007]1号（SAFE Hebei republication）
supports: 第二条 年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元（USD 50,000/person/year); 第十三条 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇：凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇 — no annual cap stated in the rule text.

title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版），汇发〔2020〕14号 — 《国务院公报》2020年第31号
supports: 第五十五条/第五十六条 individual facilitation quota USD 50,000; 第五十九条 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇 (no annual cap in rule text); 第六十二条 anti-splitting + “关注名单”; 第六十四条 境内个人外汇汇出境外：当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）凭身份证件办理，超过凭身份证件和有交易额的相关材料； 第六十五条 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外：（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理； 第八十九条 cash exit tiers; 第九十五条+ capital-account excluded from this guideline.

title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法，中国人民银行公告[2004]第16号 — 《国务院公报》2005年第22号
supports: 第二条 移民转移/继承转移; 第六条 移民转移一次性申请、分步汇出：首次 ≤ 全部申请额一半，满1年后可汇出剩余的一半，满2年后汇出全部剩余；全部申请财产 ≤ 等值人民币20万元（含）经批准后可一次性汇出; 第八条 所需材料（户籍注销证明、国外定居证明/认证、税务机关开具的税收证明或完税凭证）; 第十一条 售汇后外汇直接汇往申请人本人境外账户，不得提取外币现钞.

title: 中国人民银行有关负责人就《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》有关问题答记者问
supports: 申请金额低于等值50万元人民币由外汇局省级分局审核办理；超过等值50万元（含50万元）由省级外汇局初审后报国家外汇管理局批准；超过20万元（含20万元）移民转移采取“一次申请、分步汇出”；实施日期2004-12-01；继承转移从同一被继承人继承的全部财产只须一次性申请、可一次或分次汇出.

title: SAFE Tianjin FAQ: 境内个人外汇汇出境外用于经常项目支出，是否有额度限制？(2026-04-22)
supports: Current (2026) restatement of 汇发[2020]14号 Art. 64: FX-account remittances abroad ≤ USD 50,000 per day (cumulative) on ID; above that, ID + documents showing the transaction amount.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例，国务院令[2008]第532号 — Chapter VII Legal Liability
supports: 第三十九条 逃汇（将境内外汇私自存放境外、擅自汇出/携带/邮寄…）：处逃汇金额30%以下罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇、非法介绍买卖外汇：处违法金额30%以下罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任.

title: 关于服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案有关问题的公告，国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号
supports: 单笔支付等值5万美元以上需向主管税务机关进行税务备案；三（十三）境内个人境外留学、旅游、探亲等因私用汇无需办理备案表；四 境外个人办理服务贸易等对外支付，按个人外汇管理相关规定办理.

title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法（2018年修正）（Tianjin STA republication）
supports: 第一条 居民个人从中国境内和境外取得的所得，依照本法缴纳个人所得税；第二条 应税所得九类（含利息股息红利所得）；第三条（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十.

title: 国家税务总局关于储蓄存款利息征收个人所得税若干业务问题的通知，国税发[1999]180号（STA policy library; restates 财税〔2008〕132号）
supports: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得（包括人民币、外币储蓄利息所得）暂免征收个人所得税（财税〔2008〕132号，国务院批准）. Savings interest, both RMB and FX, is pension-exempt since 2008-10-09.

title: GACC service guide: 进出境行李物品监管（隔绝/通过信道）
publisher: General Administration of Customs of China
supports: 出境旅客携带下列物品的，应选择‘申报通道’（红色通道）：（三）人民币现钞超过20000元，或外币现钞折合超过5000美元.

title: 长沙海关问答：进出境旅客可以携带多少外币？
supports: 出境人员携出金额在等值5000美元以内（含5000美元）的，不需申领《携带证》；5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应当向银行申领《携带证》；10000美元以上的，应当向存款或购汇银行所在地外汇局申领《携带证》.

title: IRS — Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
supports: A U.S. person must file FinCEN Form 114 if the aggregate value of at least one foreign financial account exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year; due April 15, automatic extension to October 15; e-file via BSA E-Filing; records kept 5 years.

title: 31 CFR § 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
publisher: eCFR (authoritative but unofficial online; Federal Register official)
supports: Adjusted for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) foreign financial agency transaction — non-willful violation — max $16,536; 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) — willful violation — max $165,353. Per OMB M-26-11 (Apr 2026), the 2026 inflation adjustment was cancelled, so the 2025 amounts remain in effect — see FLAGS F-D11 (secondary note), regulation text is the operative source.

title: 31 U.S.C. § 5321 — Penalties (U.S.C. 2024 ed., govinfo)
supports: (a)(5)(B) non-willful penalty statutory $10,000 base; (a)(5)(C) willful penalty the greater of $100,000 (as adjusted) or 50 percent of the balance in the account at the time of the violation; (a)(5)(D) pattern of negligent activity; criminal penalties under (a)(5)(C) and 5322.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6038D — Information with respect to foreign financial assets (U.S.C. 2024 ed., govinfo)
supports: (a) attach information for specified foreign financial assets if aggregate value exceeds $50,000 (or higher prescribed amount); (d)(1) failure → $10,000; (d)(2) failure continuing >90 days after notice → $10,000 per 30-day period, max $50,000 (i.e., max $60,000 total); (g) reasonable-cause exception.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6039F — Notice of large gifts received from foreign persons (U.S.C. 2024 ed., govinfo)
supports: (a) value of foreign gifts exceeding $10,000 (adjusted for cost of living, per (d)) must be reported as the Secretary prescribes (Form 3520); (c) failure → the tax consequences of the gift are determined by the Secretary AND 5% of the foreign gift for each month (max 25%); (c)(2) reasonable-cause exception.

title: IRS — About Form 3520 (Annual Return To Report Transactions With Foreign Trusts and Receipt of Certain Foreign Gifts)
supports: U.S. persons file Form 3520 for certain large gifts or bequests from certain foreign persons. (The operative filing thresholds are set in the form instructions, which derive from § 6039F as adjusted.)

title: IRS — Foreign Tax Credit
supports: U.S. taxpayers may claim a credit for foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source income (here, China tax withheld or paid on China-source income), in lieu of a deduction.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of gain or loss from a section 988 transaction (U.S.C. 2024 ed., govinfo)
supports: FX-denominated debt gains/losses and FX-denominated sales are treated as ordinary (not capital). A CNY deposit converted to USD can generate § 988 ordinary gain/loss relative to the taxpayer's USD tax basis; if the CNY is the taxpayer's functional currency the effect shifts — see FLAGS F-D13.

title: FinCEN — Reporting of International Transportation of Currency or Monetary Instruments (> $10,000)
supports: Any person transporting, mailing or shipping currency or other monetary instruments over $10,000 (including on their person, in luggage, cargo, mail, or wire/electronic transfer system) into or out of the U.S. must file a report (FinCEN Form 105). 31 U.S.C. § 5316.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6038 — Information returns required of certain United States persons with respect to certain foreign corporations and partnerships
supports: Backdrop for corporate/partnership structures used to hold CNY assets; transfer into such structures can itself trigger foreign-form filings (Forms 5471/8865/8858) with statutory penalties. (Ownership-form specifics not expanded here — see Flagged F-D14.)

title: 中国人民银行等八部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知》，银发〔2026〕42号（2026-02-06施行）
supports: 一(一) 虚拟货币不具有与法定货币等同的法律地位；在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换、虚拟货币之间兑换、作为中央对手方买卖、信息中介、定价服务、代币发行融资及相关金融产品交易等业务活动，属于非法金融活动，一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔；境外单位和个人不得以任何形式非法向境内主体提供虚拟货币相关服务；（十八）违反本通知开展相关非法金融活动，依照有关规定予以处罚；构成犯罪的依法追究刑事责任；明知或应知仍予协助的，依法追责；（十九）任何单位和个人投资虚拟货币，相关民事法律行为无效，损失自行承担。2021年银发〔2021〕237号同时废止。RWA代币化与挂钩法定货币稳定币亦被纳管。

title: Bank of China FX board 中国银行外汇牌价 (captured 2026-11-09 05:30:00, board time UTC+8)
supports: USD row, CNY per 100 USD: 现汇买入（spot buy from customer) 666.48; 现钞买入（cash buy) 666.48; 现汇卖出（spot sell to customer — the rate a CNY→USD converter actually pays) 669.29; 现钞卖出 669.29; 中行折算价（reference) 671.68. Measured spreads: full bid–ask 0.42%; one-way vs mid 0.21%; sell vs reference 0.36% (see methodology). A measurement, not a regulation; re-capture on trade date.

title: 中国银行电子银行个人服务转账汇款费率表 （收费标准自2014-11-01起）
supports: 跨境汇款（电汇）: 每笔汇款金额的1‰，最低收取50元/笔，最高收取260元/笔；另收电讯费，港澳台地区人民币80元/笔，非港澳台地区人民币150元/笔. Ladder modeled at the COUNTER standard (most conservative published figure).

title: 中行电子银行转账汇款大优惠（2025年5–12月）
supports: 手机银行个人外币跨境汇款（向境外中行汇款）：手续费及电讯费免费；（向境外他行汇款）：在柜台标准上手续费及电讯费9折优惠. 2026 renewal NOT confirmed → counter rates used in the ladder; see Flag F-D02.

title: 中国银行转发SAFE汇发[2017]29号问答（银行卡境外大额提取现金）
publisher: Bank of China, republishing SAFE 汇发[2017]29号
supports: 个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币；每卡每日额度统一为等值1万元人民币；超过年度额度，本年及次年将被暂停；个人持卡境外消费不占用个人便利化年度5万美元购汇额度.

title: CFETS / China Foreign Exchange Trade System — CNY Central Parity (reserve reference)
supports: Official daily CNY/USD central parity. Context for why a US converter sees a board price, not the parity. Not itself a price at which a retail customer can transact.
